findings.statement: After the U.S. Supreme Court ruled the IEEPA tariffs unlawful, the government launched a refund program for the roughly $500 the company paid in those tariffs.
findings.rationale: A refund route exists for these duties, which contradicts the idea that they cannot be recovered.

quotes.text: We paid the government approximately $500 in IEEPA tariffs. In February 2026, the U.S. Supreme Court ruled that the IEEPA tariffs were unlawful. Following this ruling, the government launched a program to administer IEEPA refunds.

findings.statement: The company has actually received refunds: $184 during 2026, of which $174 was recorded as a reduction to merchandise costs and $10 as interest income.
findings.rationale: Cash was recovered and booked against merchandise costs, so the tariffs were not a pure unrecoverable cost.

quotes.text: During 2026, we began filing for refunds and received $184, made up of $174 in refunds, recorded as a reduction to merchandise costs, and $10 recorded as interest income.

findings.statement: Much of the recovery is being passed back to members rather than kept: the company intends to invest the majority of further refunds in increased value for the member, and refunds net of price investment added three basis points to gross margin.
findings.rationale: The money was clawed back, but the net benefit to the company is small because most is reinvested in lower prices.

quotes.text: Subsequent to 2026, we received $155 in additional refunds and we intend to continue to invest the majority of the refunds in increased value for the member.
IEEPA tariff refunds, net of investment in price reductions for members, positively impacted gross margin by three basis points.

findings.statement: Tariffs in general are described as more likely to hurt than help results, which fits the cost side of the claim.
findings.rationale: This is a general statement about tariffs and does not address recoverability. It supports only the idea that duties are a cost.

quotes.text: Higher tariffs are more likely to adversely impact rather than improve our results.

response.rationale: The claim is contradicted for the IEEPA tariffs: they were ruled unlawful, a refund program exists and the company has received refunds recorded against merchandise costs. Most of the money is being reinvested in lower member prices, so the net gain is small, and other duties are not shown to be recoverable.
unknowns: Whether duties other than the IEEPA tariffs can be recovered.
How much of the roughly $500 paid will ultimately be refunded and when.
How much of the refunds was reinvested in prices versus retained in dollar terms.
